facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a 7 by 7 foot metal cab; the Register calls it an Aermotor tower

access.note: Inside Itasca State Park; a 2024 visitor account describes climbing the tower to the cab.

visit.trail_note: A 2024 visitor account walked a loop south from the tower on the Deer Lake Trail.

notes_for_editor: No build year is given: the Register says only the 1920s, so there is no built event. No current fire-watch staffing was found; the Register says the tower remains in service with the park interpreter attached. Height: the Register says 80 ft; other sources say 100 ft total including the cab. The record's 30.5 m is kept. Public access rests on a 2024 visitor account and the park's exhibit; park hours and closures were not checked. The Forest Lookouts page is a hobbyist site that reproduces NGS data and is cited only for the NGS description. No photos added.
